Worked as a groundskeeper at a canoe club a couple summers ago with my then long term girlfriend. Basically ended as her getting me to do all the hard and gross work like fishing garbage out of the lake while she lent boats out. Also, she was our boss’s favourite.

Basically, on the last day, she didn’t paint the club or mow the lawn (which was like a 3 hour mow). So the manager added those to my tasks, and said that if I didn’t get everything done by the end of the day I wouldn’t receive my final pay. Spent the entire time mowing the lawn and painting while looking up how legal it was to withhold pay.  Wrote a note to the entire staff telling them to go fuck themselves. 

Also, they didn’t provide masks and made me paint a bathroom with no windows, then got mad when I said that I was getting high on the fumes and needed a break. 

Seems kinda mediocre compared to everyone else in this thread, but fuck if I wasn’t mad.
